geometry.pad_centre: on the CRBH 6013 plane (axial offset e <= 10 mm, target 0; Arms s0 2.45 @0, 1.98 @10 mm)
geometry.contact_band: z +-15 mm about the pad centre: 15.9 mm margin to the 61.8 core edges; T-030 fore-aft centroid -10/-12 mm (smoke): 19 mm margin in x
geometry.abduction: clear to 90 deg roll (Arms); interim soft limit <= 135 deg pending bryan-PC sweep

bond.prep: machined 7075 boss face: grit-blast + solvent + primer per legs/BOND_SPEC.md; bonding jig locates the core (no lips needed: bond carries shear, Materials Part 4)

lips: not needed when bonded (Materials Part 4: lips only locate); a 62 boss leaves no wall for a pocket around a 61.8 core -> locate with a jig; 0.5 mm locating rim would need a 64x64 boss (+7 g)

option_A_direct_bond.service: cartridge replacement = debond core from the arm link (heat ~ >100 C [EST] / scrape) + re-prep + re-bond 24 h cure: field service burden

option_B_replaceable_tray.tray_check: 0.5 mm tabs: bearing 307 MPa (SF 1.56 vs 480), tear-out 154 MPa (SF 2.1 vs 330)
